description: An umbrella initiative encompassing 29 sector-specific projects designed to modernize farming, improve crop yields, boost seed production, and promote high-value organic and niche crops across J&K.
benefits: 50% to 80% capital subsidies, free high-quality seeds, machinery support, and credit linkage across agriculture, horticulture, livestock, and apiculture sectors.
eligibility: Farmers, farm youth, agri-entrepreneurs, and Self-Help Groups (SHGs) residing in Jammu & Kashmir
Registration on the Kisan Khidmat Portal is mandatory

description: Encourages apple growers to transition from traditional apple orchards to High-Density Apple Plantations (HDAP) using rootstocks for higher density and early commercial yields.
benefits: 50% subsidy on setting up high-density orchards, including imported dwarf/semi-dwarf rootstocks, anti-hail net structures, drip irrigation, and trellising systems.
eligibility: Individual orchardists, land-owning farmers, or registered grower groups in J&K
Minimum land area holding of 1 Kanal (0.125 acre) dedicated to high-density setup
application_mode: Online via HADP / J&K Horticulture Portal

description: Aims to boost the productivity of world-renowned Kashmiri Saffron by supporting corm multiplication, drip irrigation setup, and access to India International Saffron Trade Centre (IISTC) for grading and processing.
benefits: Subsidized high-quality saffron corms, 100% assistance for solar irrigation connections, and free quality testing/e-auction access at IISTC Dussu, Pulwama.
eligibility: Traditional saffron growers and new farmers in notified saffron belts (Pulwama, Budgam, Srinagar, and Kishtwar districts)
documents: Land Revenue Certificate confirming Saffron Land status
application_mode: Online via HADP Portal / Offline via District Agriculture Officer

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri / LG Green Cold Chain & Post-Harvest Scheme
description: Provides financial support to build Controlled Atmosphere (CA) cold stores, refrigerated vans, and pack houses to prevent post-harvest losses of perishable fruits like apples, cherries, and walnuts.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹2 Crore per project) for constructing CA stores, solar-powered pack-houses, and cold chain transport.
eligibility: Agri-entrepreneurs, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), Cooperatives, and individual orchardists in J&K
application_mode: Online via J&K HADP / Horticulture Department Portal

scheme_name: J&K Integrated Sheep & Goat Development Scheme (ISGDS)
description: Encourages establishment of sheep and goat breeding units to meet local mutton demand, boost Pashmina/wool production, and generate rural employment.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy up to ₹1,25,000 for setting up 25-ewe/doe units, plus free veterinary care, tagging, and insurance coverage.
eligibility: Unemployed youth, small and marginal farmers, and nomadic migratory tribals (Gujjars/Bakarwals) residing in J&K
application_mode: Online via Kisan Khidmat / Offline via District Sheep Husbandry Officer

description: Promotes commercial cultivation of high-value medicinal and aromatic plants such as Lavender, Rose, Muskmelon, and Rosemary under the Lavender / Purple Revolution banner.
benefits: Free supply of quality planting material (QPM/cuttings), 50% subsidy on distillation units, and direct market buyback linkages through CSIR-IIIM.
eligibility: Farmers owning cultivable hilly or rainfed land across all districts of J&K, especially Doda, Ramban, Kishtwar, and Kashmir valley
application_mode: Online via HADP Portal / CSIR-IIIM Jammu

description: Supports silk farmers by providing high-yielding mulberry saplings, rearing appliances, and financial grants for constructing modern silkworm rearing houses.
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹1,25,000 for constructing rearing houses, free mulberry saplings, and subsidized silkworm seed (chawki) supplies.
eligibility: Traditional silk rearers, women SHGs, and smallholders in J&K having space for mulberry cultivation
documents: Land Record Extract for Mulberry Plantation
application_mode: Offline via Sericulture Development Department Offices or Online via HADP Portal

description: Promotes scientific beekeeping for honey and beeswax production, boosting overall crop pollination and generating supplementary farm income.
benefits: 80% subsidy for SC/ST/Women beneficiaries and 50% for General category on purchase of bee hives, colonies, honey extractors, and migration transportation.
eligibility: Farmers, rural youth, and SHG groups residing in Jammu & Kashmir
application_mode: Online via HADP / Kisan Khidmat Portal

scheme_name: Trout Culture & Commercial Aquaculture Incentive Scheme
description: Promotes commercial cold-water trout farming in running water raceways across high-altitude streams and carp culture in plain areas.
benefits: 40% subsidy for General and 60% for SC/ST/Women on constructing running-water trout raceways (up to ₹5,50,000 per unit cost base), fish seed, and floating feed.
eligibility: Unemployed youth, small farmers, and cooperative groups in J&K with suitable land and perennial cold water supply
documents: NOC / Water Feasibility Certificate from Jal Shakti Department
application_mode: Online via Kisan Khidmat / Offline via District Fisheries Officer

scheme_name: J&K Solar Pump / Micro-Irrigation Promotion Scheme
description: Encourages farmers in off-grid or rainfed areas to install solar-powered irrigation pumpsets integrated with drip and sprinkler irrigation units.
benefits: Up to 80% combined central and UT subsidy on solar water pump setups (up to 10 HP) and 80% subsidy on drip/sprinkler micro-irrigation kits.
eligibility: Farmers holding agricultural land in J&K without regular electricity supply for irrigation
